tools.name: starshipit_list_unshipped_orders
tools.description: List unshipped (new, not yet printed) orders with full details: addresses, items, packages, carrier. By default only orders updated in the last 24 hours; use since_order_date / since_last_updated to look further back. ids_only=true returns just the order ids. GET /api/orders/unshipped.

tools.name: starshipit_list_shipped_orders
tools.description: List shipped orders (label printed) with tracking number, tracking status, carrier, manifest and shipped date. By default only orders updated in the last 24 hours; use since_last_updated to look further back. Label files are not returned. GET /api/orders/shipped.

tools.name: starshipit_list_printed_orders
tools.description: List orders whose label was recently printed, or printed but not yet manifested, with tracking numbers. GET /api/orders/shipments.

tools.name: starshipit_list_delivered_orders
tools.description: List delivered orders that carry a given order reference (the customer reference), with full order details. GET /api/orders/delivered.

tools.name: starshipit_orders_summary
tools.description: A compact list of orders in one status (new, printed, shipped, archived) with contact, country, carrier, weight, manifest and dates, plus account-wide counts (unprinted, printed, shipped, archived, invalid addresses, returns). Supports filters and sorting. GET /api/orders/summary.

tools.name: starshipit_search_orders
tools.description: Search orders by order number, tracking number, customer reference or recipient name (phrase), optionally limited to unshipped or shipped orders. Returns id, number, date, name, carrier, tracking number and country. GET /api/orders/search.

tools.name: starshipit_get_order
tools.description: One order by Starshipit order_id or by the order_number from the source platform. Use include to add sections (Items, Packages, Events, Metadatas, Shipping_Price, ...). Status defaults to Unshipped in Starshipit, so pass status=Shipped or Printed for orders already printed. Label files are not retur

tools.name: starshipit_list_orders
tools.description: List full order details for one status (Unshipped by default, or Shipped / Printed), narrowed by a filter such as `Order:::1419,Country:::Australia` and sorted. Heavier than the summary: use starshipit_orders_summary for overviews. Label files are not returned. GET /api/orders (no id).

tools.name: starshipit_track_shipment
tools.description: Tracking details for a shipped order, by tracking number or by order number: status, carrier, tracking URL, shipment date and the carrier's tracking events. GET /api/track.

tools.name: starshipit_get_rates
tools.description: QUOTE ONLY: shipping rates (service name, code, price) for a destination and parcels from the couriers enabled in the account. Nothing is purchased, created or printed. The sender defaults to the account's pickup address. Needs at least one enabled courier. POST /api/rates.

tools.name: starshipit_list_delivery_services
tools.description: QUOTE ONLY: the carrier delivery services available for a shipment (carrier, service name and code) and, with include_pricing, their prices and service options. Nothing is purchased, created or printed. POST /api/deliveryservices.

tools.name: starshipit_list_address_book
tools.description: List contacts in the account's address book (name, company, address, phone, email), sorted by a column. GET /api/addressbook/filtered.

tools.name: starshipit_list_manifests
tools.description: List manifests already submitted to carriers (newest first): number, date, carrier, package and consignment counts. Read only; manifesting is not available here. GET /api/manifests.

tools.name: starshipit_list_products
tools.description: List Product Catalogue records (SKU, title, weight, dimensions, HS code, bin location, price), optionally searching by SKU or title. GET /api/products.

tools.name: starshipit_list_tags
tools.description: List the account's user-defined order tags, optionally filtered by tag name. GET /api/tags.

tools.name: starshipit_list_pickups
tools.description: List courier pickups already booked for the account. Read only; booking a pickup is not available here. GET /api/pickup.

tools.name: starshipit_create_order
tools.description: WRITE: create ONE new UNSHIPPED order in Starshipit (order number, destination, optional items, parcels, sender). No label is printed, no shipment is booked and no postage is bought; staff still print the label in Starshipit. Not idempotent: creating the same order_number twice may create a duplicat

tools.name: starshipit_update_order
tools.description: WRITE: change details of ONE UNSHIPPED order by order_id (the order is read first and refused if it is already printed or shipped): addresses, shipping method/carrier/service, items, packages, reference or an internal note. This tool never sends status or manifest flags. It does not print a label or

tools.name: starshipit_add_order_tags
tools.description: WRITE: add up to 10 tags to ONE UNSHIPPED order (read first; refused if printed or shipped) (a tag that does not exist yet is created). Tags are used for filtering and can drive the account's automation rules. Adding a tag the order already has changes nothing. Tags are not removed. POST /api/tags/o

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: starshipit_track_shipment, starshipit_get_rates, starshipit_list_delivery_services, starshipit_list_address_book, starshipit_create_order, starshipit_add_order_tags · Private data: starshipit_list_shipped_orders, starshipit_orders_summary, starshipit_get_order, starshipit_list_orders, starshipit_list_address_book, starshipit_list_products · Public sink: starshipit_get_rates, starshipit_list_delivery_services, starshipit_list_address_book, starshipit_create_order, starshipit_update_order, starshipit_add_order_tags · Destructive: starshipit_create_order, starshipit_update_order.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: starshipit_track_shipment, starshipit_get_rates, starshipit_list_delivery_services, starshipit_list_address_book, starshipit_create_order, starshipit_add_order_tags · Private data: starshipit_list_shipped_orders, starshipit_orders_summary, starshipit_get_order, starshipit_list_orders, starshipit_list_address_book, starshipit_list_products · Public sink: starshipit_get_rates, starshipit_list_delivery_services, starshipit_list_address_book, starshipit_create_order, starshipit_update_order, starshipit_add_order_tags · Destructive: starshipit_create_order, starshipit_update_order

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
